name: com.innov8tif.okayid.cam.ScanningActivity
description: OkayID Mobile (Innov8tif identity-document SDK) checks camera frames for a steady, clear document image. When it finds one, it passes the photo to its text-recognition screen; the user can also skip directly to that screen.
disableEffect: The app loses OkayID Mobile assisted scanning and cannot use this automatic image check if this screen is disabled.
